name: adlc-next
description: Explicit-only skills for handing a software task to an agent and having it carried through investigation, implementation, review, and rework to the requested delivery point.

interface.shortDescription: Delegate a software task once and get it carried through.
interface.longDescription: ADLC Next packages explicit-only skills for agent-driven software delivery: sdlc-solve owns a delegated task from investigation to the requested delivery point, sdlc-implement builds an already clear specification with self-checks, and sdlc-review checks work against its current requirements. A shared task file keeps paused and handed-off work resumable.
defaultPrompt: Use $adlc-next:sdlc-solve to fix this bug and verify the result.
Use $adlc-next:sdlc-implement to implement the attached spec.
Use $adlc-next:sdlc-review to review the current branch against its task.
